summary: Corteva, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting that subsidiary Vylor Inc. extended the expiration of private exchange offers and consent solicitations for EIDP, Inc. notes maturing 2030 (2.300%), 2032 (5.125%), and 2033 (4.800%). The registered securities are CTVA common stock and EIDP preferred series CTAPrA/CTAPrB. No exchange ratio, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed in the excerpt beyond the extension itself. The mechanics involve eligible-holder participation, likely a Regulation S/144A exchange tied to indenture amendments. Watch for amended terms, participation thresholds, and whether consent conditions clear by the new deadline.
